sources.source_en: Give a small comic interruption an identifiable visible stimulus and two contrasting responses in the same connected space; the affected person may retain a composed face while the other visibly struggles to suppress a smile.

criteria: The water/shoulder mishap remains an identifiable visible stimulus in the same connected scene as both reactions.
The affected participant shows composed/deadpan expression or posture while the partner visibly struggles to contain a smile; the contrast is directed at their shared situation.
A generic pair of undifferentiated pleasant smiles alone is insufficient to establish the selected contrasting-expression refinement.
overlap_note: Two retained source references support one overlapping local expression refinement; do not count them as two independent image improvements.
